regions.today: This evening will remain mostly cloudy across Leinster with some patchy drizzle in places, mainly over the northern half of the region. Staying drier further south. Some sunny spells will also occur, the best of these in the south and east. Breezy with moderate to fresh, gusting strong to near gale at times, west to north-westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry for some with a mixture of clear spells and cloud. However, there will be some patchy drizzle and mist in places. Cloud will increase from the west overnight. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees with moderate westerly breezes decreasing light southwesterly.
regions.tomorrow: Monday will be mostly cloudy with some light rain or drizzle in the north of the province. Drier further south with just patchy drizzle and some brighter intervals. Highest temperatures of 17 to 22 degrees with moderate southwest breezes, warmest in the south.
